milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/observe vines on the jungle wall. Vines are at (-2 to 0, y=1-5, z=-11) on the south face of the jungle log wall. Max_distance=5 requires the player to walk ~6 blocks south from spawn to be within range. Player must face south toward the vines.

Uses position_near_with_facing with max_distance=4 to enforce vine climbing. Acacia logs are at (0,7,-11) on the elevated platform (y=6). From ground level at the wall base (y=1, z=-11), 3D distance to target is sqrt(0+36+0)=6 which exceeds 4. From the platform (y=6, z=-11), distance is sqrt(0+1+0)=1 which is within 4. This ensures the player must climb vines to trigger the milestone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find and read the birch sign with directional text. Sign is at (5, 2, -1) on a fence post. Distance from spawn is sqrt(25+1+1)≈5.2 blocks. Max_distance=4 requires the player to walk east to reading distance and face the sign.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/observe red tulips in the garden at (8-11, 1, 4-7). Target is garden center at (9,1,5). Distance from spawn is sqrt(81+0+25)≈10.3 blocks. Max_distance=6 requires navigating northeast to be within the garden area.

Uses inventory_has because using an empty bucket on a water source block converts it to water_bucket in inventory. Player starts with an empty bucket. The water pool is at (12-14, 0, -1 to 1). Having water_bucket confirms successful collection.

Uses inventory_has because breaking sugar cane drops sugar_cane items into inventory. Sugar cane is at (6, y=1-3, z=-7/-5/-3) on the river bank. No tool required. Having at least 1 sugar_cane confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_basalt with the provided iron pickaxe drops polished_basalt as an item. The basalt structure is at (x=-6 to -3, z=-4 to -1). Player starts without polished_basalt, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing with max_distance=3 because the birch button is hidden inside a sealed polished basalt chamber at (-5, 2, -2). The chamber interior is only 2x2x2 blocks. Player must mine through the basalt walls to enter and face the button. From outside the structure at (-3,1,-2), distance to target is sqrt(4+1+0)≈2.2 which barely triggers — but the facing requirement toward (-5,2,-2) from outside would require facing INTO the solid wall, which combined with the tight distance makes false positives unlikely.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the orange wall banners marking the village entrance. Banners are at (-2,3,5) and (2,3,5) above the archway. Target is the midpoint at (0,3,5). Max_distance=5 requires the player to navigate north along the path to the village wall and face the banners.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find the potato farm inside the enclosed village compound. Potatoes are at (x=-3 to 2, z=8 and z=10). Target is farm center at (0,1,9). Max_distance=5 requires the player to enter through the archway and be inside the village walls to trigger.

Uses inventory_has because successfully trading with the armorer villager (at (3,1,9), NoAI) for iron leggings places the item in inventory. Player has 20 emeralds (7 required per trade). Player starts without iron_leggings, so having at least 1 confirms successful trade completion.

Uses inventory_has because crafting jungle_stairs at the crafting table (2,1,-10) produces 4 stairs per recipe from 6 jungle planks. Player must retrieve planks from chest on acacia platform (2,7,-11), descend, and craft. Having at least 4 jungle_stairs confirms one successful craft operation.
